description: This Java class defines a custom web tag called PageContentTag used to retrieve and display content content based on a content code within a web application. It interacts with content service, handles autowiring, and outputs content into the web page.

classes.name: PageContentTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag for dynamically retrieving and displaying page content based on a content code, integrating with Spring's content service and handling autowiring.

methods.name: getContentCode
methods.description: Getter for the content code identifier used to fetch specific content.

methods.name: setContentCode
methods.description: Setter for the content code identifier.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Main logic executed when the tag starts; ensures autowiring, retrieves content based on code, and outputs it.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Handles tag end lifecycle; simply returns EVAL_PAGE to continue processing.
